coverage_notes: Completed 12 bounded targeted web searches across the four audited miss classes: only/sole/last/full-service grocery loss or closure; emergency food-distribution cancellations or suspensions from storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage; abrupt pantry/food-bank service closures or major access reductions; and official SNAP/WIC interruptions with immediate access consequences.
